stages.narrative: A product initiative or failing internal detector creates a need for managed intelligence.
A product director or integration partner introduces the vendor and technical demonstration.
The lead reviews samples, isolation, permissions, ID mapping, commercial units and recovery responsibilities.
A sandbox exercises feeds, offsets, duplicate deliveries, version changes and delays.
Certified cohorts run with monitored delivery contracts and a named escalation route.
The integration stays when compatibility, recovery and transparent usage keep its operating burden acceptable.

stages.narrative: Missed endings or lengthy browsing motivate the viewer to reconsider the operator service or package.
A friend, the operator website or an advertised demonstration introduces the enhanced viewing offer.
The viewer compares content, device support, price and premium ad behavior before trying the offer.
A service trial or first feature use tests a familiar programme or sport on their device.
Previews, chapters and replay enhancements become routine inside the operator’s app.
The viewer retains the operator service when it saves time and preserves trust; no direct vendor relationship is created.
